items.title: 13.3.1 Types of Animals on the basis of Heat Source (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ectotherms and endotherms (PDF 7-8).

items: Ectotherms zyada tar hararat bahar se lete hain; un ka darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath chalta hai. Zyada tar invertebrates, aur machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles ectotherms hain. Un ka metabolism unhein garam rakhne ke liye bohat sust hai, to woh rawayye se kaam lete hain: thand mein dhoop sekna (radiation) ya garam patthar par letna (conduction), aur garmi mein saya dhoondna ya bil mein jana; bohat thande ilaqon mein khwabeeda (dormant) ho jate hain.

Endotherms zyada tar hararat andaruni metabolism se paida karte aur kafi mustaqil darja-e-hararat rakhte hain, aksar mahol se zyada. Parinde aur mammals endotherms hain; thand mein kaampte ya brown adipose tissue jalate hain, aur zyada tar mein baal, par ya charbi jaisi insulation hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Jism ki hararat ke maakhaz ki bunyad par janwaron ki darja-bandi kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms mahol se hararat lete aur rawayye se qaboo karte (machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles, zyada tar invertebrates); endotherms metabolism se hararat banate aur insulation se rakhte (parinde, mammals).

items: Ectotherms: bahar ki hararat aur rawayya. Endotherms: metabolism ki hararat aur insulation.
